page.layout: One column of names, running down the centre of the page, with dates in the right margin beside each group of four lines. A note in the left margin, in two lines, stands beside the third group.
page.notes: The small mark before "Albertus" (line 4 and 15 of the list, 1347 group) and before "Alardus" is a decorative sign, not transcribed. "Stavëram" is uncertain: the accent over the e is faint. "dña" for the abbreviation in "F. dña Ava." is a best reading and may be "dñ. Avæ" or similar. The left-margin note is set in two lines with a hyphen at the line end; it is written here as one word. The dates are placed as notes beside the first name of each group.
